links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy versus radiologists across input types (raw images, expert or resident structured features)
links.effect: With expert features GPT-4o reached 94.3% vs expert 92.5% (p=1.000) and resident 79.2% (p=0.021); with raw images LLMs 18.9-52.8%, significantly worse than radiologists (p<0.05). Not tested as human-AI teams.
links.quote: With expert-derived structured features, LLMs achieved high accuracy (86.8-94.3%), with GPT-4o reaching 94.3% (95%CI 84.6-98.1%), matching the expert neuroradiologist (92.5%, 95%CI 82.1-97.0%, p = 1.000) and significantly outperforming the resident (79.2%, p = 0.021).

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy compared with neuroradiologists, residents, and machine learning baselines on the same cases
links.effect: GPT-4o matched expert neuroradiologist with expert features (94.3% vs 92.5%) and beat resident (79.2%); with raw images all LLMs were significantly worse than radiologists (p<0.05).
links.quote: Performance was moderate with resident-derived structured features (71.7-73.6%), significantly better than raw image input (p < 0.05), but declined markedly with raw images alone (18.9-52.8%), where all LLMs performed significantly worse than radiologists (p < 0.05).

links.outcome: LLM accuracy under varied input quality (expert vs resident structured features vs raw images)
links.effect: Accuracy fell from 86.8-94.3% (expert features) to 71.7-73.6% (resident features) to 18.9-52.8% (raw images), showing brittleness to input variation.
links.quote: Performance degrades moderately with resident-derived features and dramatically with raw image input, highlighting the critical importance of structured prompting for clinical LLM applications.

unlisted_practices: Structured expert-derived textual feature prompting to improve multimodal LLM diagnostic accuracy

screen.reason: The study directly compares LLM diagnostic performance across different input/prompting strategies (raw image inputs vs resident-derived structured text vs expert-derived structured text features).

primary.practice: structured feature prompting vs raw image input
